package migrated

import (
	"github.com/weiloon1234/Foundry-Go/http"
)

func foldExpression() http.Registration {
	profile := http.Authenticated(endpoint, users)
	return http.ConfigureAuthenticated(profile, http.Scopes(read), http.Permissions(viewer)).Handle(handler)
}

func foldReassign() http.Registration {
	secured := http.Authenticated(endpoint, users)
	// the rule is declared below
	secured = http.ConfigureAuthenticated(secured, http.Scopes(read), http.Permissions(editor)) // both
	return secured.Handle(handler)
}

func foldNested() http.Registration {
	return http.ConfigureAuthenticated(http.Authenticated(endpoint, users), http.Permissions(viewer)).Handle(handler)
}

func foldKeepsActors() http.Registration {
	e := http.Authenticated(endpoint, users)
	e = http.ConfigureAuthenticated(e, http.Scopes(read), http.ActorMiddleware[User](audit), http.Permissions(viewer))
	return e.Handle(handler)
}

func foldMerges() http.Registration {
	e := http.Authenticated(endpoint, users, http.Scopes(read))
	return http.ConfigureAuthenticated(e, http.Permissions(viewer)).Handle(handler)
}

func foldAnyOf() http.Registration {
	e := http.Authenticated(endpoint, users)
	return http.ConfigureAuthenticated(e, http.AnyOf(http.AllOf(http.Permissions(viewer)), http.AllOf(http.Scopes(read)))).Handle(handler)
}

func foldInList() []http.Registration {
	a := http.Authenticated(endpoint, users)
	b := http.Authenticated(endpoint, users)
	return []http.Registration{
		http.ConfigureAuthenticated(a, http.Scopes(read)).Handle(handler),
		http.ConfigureAuthenticated(b, http.Scopes(write), http.Permissions(editor)).Handle(handler),
	}
}
